changelog: The My Account and Track an order tracking table uses WooCommerce's shop_table_responsive, so it stacks on phones; the link cell is an actions cell, with no stray ": " label; the section has space below it. Template version 1.4.1. A Playwright check at 375 px covers both pages.
The orders list's Complete quick action takes the Shipped label (woocommerce_admin_order_actions).
The status poll orders open orders by when they were last checked, oldest first, so every one is reached instead of the first 50 again and again.

Fulfillments\CoreSync catches errors from WooCommerce's Order Fulfillments beta: it logs them, switches the sync off for the request, and records a failed backfill to retry on the next WooCommerce version.
The update check's request sends Creative Tracking/<version> as its user agent; WordPress's default names the site.
Deactivation unschedules every job in Plugin::JOBS; uninstall also deletes the backfill marker.

Releases run the full CI workflow first (release.yml calls ci.yml); third-party actions are pinned to commit SHAs. A weekly workflow tests against WooCommerce's latest stable release, outside the release gate.
